title: Termwise single restriction factor identities
statement: For a module M and a commuting open square, (1) the exact restriction homotopy factorization followed by Qh of its mapped-single comparison equals the exact derived single restriction comparison; (2) restriction of Qh of the mapped-single comparison for tensor pullback k, followed by the constructed target isomorphism, equals the exact restriction factorization, Qh of the homotopy tensor restriction isomorphism, Qh of tensor pullback j applied to the restriction single comparison, and Qh of the mapped-single comparison for j, in that order. These are termwise identities, with no derived tensor counit. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps].

proof.text: Expand mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and cancel quotientCompQhIso factors to prove (1). For (2), use naturality of the exact restriction factorization to move the localized mapped-single comparison past it; then expand the homotopy composition isomorphisms and use singleMapHomologicalComplex naturality and composition compatibility. In degree zero the maps agree by the constructed underived tensor restriction isomorphism; in other degrees they are maps between zero objects. Apply the quotient and Qh.

lean.statement: theorem open_pinned_single_tensor_restriction_factors [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive] {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme) (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k) (M : X.Modules) : let P := (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M let H := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj M let qR := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).map ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (schemeOpenRestriction X U) (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app M) let qk := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).map ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k) (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app M) let qj := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).map ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j) (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app H) (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map qR = ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M ∧ (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map qk) ≫ (openPinnedSingleTargetRestrictionIso k U U' j hj).hom.app M = (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) |>.obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso k U U' j hj).hom.app P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) |>.map qR) ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map qj
